Elite Dangerous Beginner Flight Guide

Community discussion by a player

In Elite Dangerous, a beginner pilot should prepare a short courier mission before attempting longer journeys.

Follow these instructions to complete your first mission.

Read the courier mission destination carefully and check the route on the galaxy map. Refuel at the station before departure, and practice docking before carrying cargo. Leave enough credits for another attempt if the trip goes wrong.

For your first courier mission, check the destination distance and carry enough fuel before departure.
